title: Unnecessary console output when progress is disabled
detail: The progress display was still outputting a blank line when disabled, especially on non-interactive consoles. This was due to the lack of a check for `self.disable` before printing.

title: Test for no output when progress is disabled
detail: A new test case was added to ensure that no output is produced when the progress display is disabled, particularly on non-interactive consoles.

title: Breaking change in accept_html
detail: The `accept_html` property no longer matches XHTML or XML, which may break existing code relying on this behavior.

title: Deprecation warning for accept_xhtml
detail: The `accept_xhtml` property is deprecated and will be removed in Werkzeug 4.0. Users should transition to using `in` or `best_match`.
